# Champion Footballer

> Champion Footballer is the ultimate football management platform for creating leagues, tracking player stats, organizing matches, and viewing real-time player leaderboards.

Champion Footballer provides comprehensive tools for amateur and professional football players, league managers, and fans to track performance metrics, manage match schedules, and calculate player ratings dynamically.

## Core Features & Navigation

- [Home Dashboard](https://championfootballer.co.uk/home): Central dashboard displaying user stats, active leagues, and quick actions.
- [All Leagues](https://championfootballer.co.uk/all-leagues): Browse, search, filter, and join football leagues.
- [All Players](https://championfootballer.co.uk/all-players): Explore player profiles, career statistics, and individual ratings.
- [All Matches](https://championfootballer.co.uk/all-matches): View upcoming fixtures, match details, and match results.
- [Leaderboard](https://championfootballer.co.uk/leader-board): Official rankings, top scorers, and player leaderboards.

- [Terms & Conditions](https://championfootballer.co.uk/terms): Platform terms of service and usage rules.
